text: high prio = gold/orange, low prio = dark blue

status.comment: Priority mode now maps low/non-positive priority to dark blue and the highest priority to gold-orange; implementation is internally verified and awaits Felix's visual acceptance.

reflection: Fixed the reversed priority palette. Extracted priorityColor as a pure helper: non-positive priorities are dark blue (#0b2545), finite values interpolate toward gold-orange (#f59e0b), and positive infinity is gold-orange. Replaced the old orange→azure mapping in useGraphSimulation. Verification: 8 focused frontend tests pass across priority color and graph forces; frontend vue-tsc passes; git diff --check passes.
